title: Dining Hall Survey
transcript: Hi everyone, quick announcement from dining services. We're planning next semester's menu, and we'd like to hear from you. There's a short survey on the campus app, and it takes about five minutes. Everyone who finishes it by the end of the month gets a coupon for a free smoothie at the café. Last year, the survey is how we added the vegetarian station, so your answers really do make a difference.

questions.stem: What are listeners asked to do?
options: Buy a smoothie at the café
Complete a survey about the menu
questions.explanation: Dining services asks students to fill out a short survey on the campus app.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention the vegetarian station?
options: To advertise a new menu item
To show that survey responses lead to changes
To explain why the café is closing
To compare this year's menu with last year's
questions.explanation: The vegetarian station was added because of last year's survey, showing that answers matter.
